text: Which Georgian harbour near St Austell has stood in for old Truro in Poldark?
info: Charlestown, Cornwall; its square-rigged ships and harbour were used in Poldark.

text: Which turquoise cove on the Lizard peninsula appeared in Poldark?
info: Kynance Cove, on the west side of the Lizard in Cornwall.

text: Which Oxfordshire village plays Downton's own village in Downton Abbey?
info: Bampton, in west Oxfordshire; its library was Downton's cottage hospital.

text: Which Wiltshire National Trust village has appeared in Downton Abbey, Harry Potter and Pride and Prejudice?
info: Lacock, near Chippenham; Lacock Abbey's cloisters were Hogwarts corridors.

text: Which West Yorkshire town gave its name to Sally Wainwright's 'Last Tango'?
Which Derbyshire stately home played Mr Darcy's Pemberley in the 2005 Pride and Prejudice?
info: Chatsworth House, in the Peak District, home of the Dukes of Devonshire.

text: Which limestone cliff in the Yorkshire Dales appeared in Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows?
info: Malham Cove, near Settle in the Yorkshire Dales.

text: Which model village near Bradford did Sir Titus Salt build for his mill workers?
info: Saltaire, beside the River Aire near Shipley; a World Heritage Site.
